Goal.title: Algebra Awakening: Quadratic, Simultaneous & Rearranging Mastery
Goal.description: Covers Chapters 1–3: Quadratic Equations (split into two quests), Simultaneous Equations, and Rearranging Formulae. Total planned workload: 2 hours (120 minutes).

Goal.title: Biology Emergency Review: 10-Chapter Sprint
Goal.description: Covers Chapters 1–10: Cell Structure, Enzymes, Transport, Photosynthesis, Respiration, Inheritance, Ecology, Immunity, Nervous System, and Homeostasis, totalling 686 minutes (~11.4 hours) before the 2026-10-04 deadline.

Quest.title: Ch 1: Quadratic Equations - Core Factorising & Solving
Quest.description: Master expanding double brackets, factorising monic and non-monic quadratics, difference of two squares, and solving quadratic equations by factorising. Complete targeted drills on roots and bracket-setting.

Quest.title: Ch 1: Quadratic Equations - Completing Square, Formula & Graphs
Quest.description: Master completing the square, turning points and line of symmetry, the quadratic formula, quadratic graph features, graphical solutions, and forming/solving quadratics from context. Practice mixed method-selection questions.

Quest.title: Ch 2: Simultaneous Equations
Quest.description: Solve linear simultaneous equations by elimination and substitution, interpret solutions graphically, handle one linear and one quadratic equation, line-circle intersections, and form simultaneous equations from worded problems.

Quest.title: Ch 3: Rearranging Formulae
Quest.description: Change the subject of a formula using inverse operations, including subject once, subject twice with factorising, subject in a fraction, and formulae with powers/roots. Distinguish rearranging from solving.

Quest.title: Ch 1: Cell Structure
Quest.description: Master microscopy and magnification calculations, organelle ultrastructure, prokaryotic vs eukaryotic and plant vs animal cell differences, the fluid-mosaic membrane model, and cell fractionation; complete calculations and labelling practice.

Quest.title: Ch 2: Enzymes
Quest.description: Master enzyme action models, factors affecting rate, inhibition types, immobilised enzymes, and graph-based rate calculations; complete practical-style questions and graph interpretation.

Quest.title: Ch 3: Transport
Quest.description: Master diffusion, osmosis, active transport, co-transport, water potential, Fick's law, surface-area-to-volume ratio, xylem/phloem, transpiration, translocation, cardiac cycle, blood vessels, and tissue fluid formation; complete calculation and diagram questions.

Quest.title: Ch 4: Photosynthesis
Quest.description: Master chloroplast structure, pigment absorption, photolysis, cyclic/non-cyclic photophosphorylation, chemiosmosis, Calvin cycle intermediates (RuBP, GP, TP), limiting factors, compensation point, and chromatography/Hill reaction practicals; complete stoichiometry and graph questions.

Quest.title: Ch 5: Respiration
Quest.description: Master glycolysis, link reaction, Krebs cycle, oxidative phosphorylation, chemiosmosis, ATP yield accounting, anaerobic pathways, respiratory quotient, and respirometer practicals; complete pathway ordering and practical data questions.

Quest.title: Ch 6: Inheritance
Quest.description: Master DNA/RNA structure, semi-conservative replication, mitosis vs meiosis, genetic crosses, codominance, sex linkage, chi-squared, pedigrees, gene control, and protein synthesis; complete cross and statistical practice.

Quest.title: Ch 7: Ecology
Quest.description: Master energy flow, trophic levels, pyramids, GPP/NPP, carbon and nitrogen cycles, succession, population dynamics, sampling (quadrats, transects, Lincoln index), and conservation; complete definitions and sampling calculations.

Quest.title: Ch 8: Immunity
Quest.description: Master non-specific defences, phagocytosis, clonal selection, T-cell types, primary/secondary response, active/passive immunity, vaccination, HIV/AIDS, and monoclonal antibodies; complete immune-response sequencing and definition questions.

Quest.title: Ch 9: Nervous System
Quest.description: Master neurone structure, resting and action potentials, saltatory conduction, synaptic transmission, summation, reflex arc, and sensory receptors; complete membrane-potential and synapse questions.

Quest.title: Ch 10: Homeostasis
Quest.description: Master negative/positive feedback, thermoregulation, nephron and ADH osmoregulation, blood glucose control, diabetes types, liver function, and cell signalling; complete feedback-loop and nephron diagram questions.

Quest.title: Enzymes practice: mixed exam-style questions
Quest.description:
Answer a mixed set of enzyme exam-style questions and correct all errors.

Done when: Complete at least eight mixed questions and write corrections for every error.

Quest.title: Enzymes review: practical investigations
Quest.description:
Review variables, controls and reliability in enzyme practical investigations.

Done when: Write a variable table for one enzyme investigation with independent, dependent and two control variables.

Quest.title: Enzymes timed practice: practical and data questions
Quest.description:
Complete timed questions on enzyme practicals, data interpretation and error identification.

Done when: Finish the timed set and write one correction for each data-interpretation error.

Quest.title: Enzymes recall: full topic summary
Quest.description:
Write a one-page summary of enzymes from memory, covering structure, rate factors, inhibition and practicals.

Done when: Recall the core points from memory, then check and correct the gaps.

Quest.title: Enzymes timed practice: full-topic set
Quest.description:
Complete a timed full-topic enzyme question set and record time and accuracy.

Done when: Finish the timed set within 40 minutes and record two areas for final review.

Quest.title: Enzymes review: error log and corrections
Quest.description:
Review the error log from timed practice and rewrite corrected answers for recurring mistakes.

Done when: Rewrite corrected answers for at least three recurring errors from the error log.

Quest.title: Enzymes practice: graph and calculation questions
Quest.description:
Answer graph-reading and simple rate-calculation questions on enzymes.

Done when: Complete at least five graph or calculation questions and correct any errors.

Quest.title: Enzymes recall: key definitions and equations
Quest.description:
Write key enzyme definitions and any rate equations from memory, then check accuracy.

Done when: Produce a definitions list with at least six correct terms and one correct rate equation.

Quest.title: Enzymes timed practice: mixed question set
Quest.description:
Complete a timed mixed enzyme question set covering all subtopics.

Done when: Finish the timed set within 40 minutes and list two remaining weak areas.

Quest.title: Enzymes review: weak areas from timed practice
Quest.description:
Review the two weak areas identified in timed practice and write targeted summary notes.

Done when: Write targeted summary notes for both weak areas with at least three correct points each.

Quest.title: Enzymes practice: exam-style extended answers
Quest.description:
Write extended answers to enzyme questions, focusing on structure, rate factors and inhibition.

Done when: Write at least three extended answers and self-check each against key points.

Quest.title: Enzymes timed practice: final mixed set
Quest.description:
Complete a final timed mixed enzyme question set and record accuracy and timing.

Done when: Finish the timed set within 40 minutes and record accuracy and two final review points.

Quest.title: Enzymes review: final error correction
Quest.description:
Review the final timed set errors and rewrite corrected answers for any recurring mistakes.

Done when: Rewrite corrected answers for at least two errors from the final timed set.

Quest.title: Enzymes final review: key points and definitions
Quest.description:
Review the one-page summary, definitions and error log for a final consolidated check.

Done when: Read the summary, definitions and error log, and write three points to remember in the exam.

Quest.title: Enzymes: recall active site from memory
Quest.description:
Write from memory the roles of active site, substrate and enzyme-substrate complex, then check against notes.

Done when: Produce a labelled recall sheet with at least five correct statements about active site and specificity.

Quest.title: Enzymes practice: factors affecting rate
Quest.description:
Answer short questions on temperature, pH and substrate concentration effects, then mark and correct errors.

Done when: Complete at least six short-answer questions and write one correction for each error.

Quest.title: Enzymes review: rate graphs and denaturation
Quest.description:
Review graph shapes for enzyme rate and explain denaturation in terms of active site shape.

Done when: Annotate two rate graphs and write a two-sentence explanation of denaturation.

Quest.title: Enzymes timed practice: mixed short answers
Quest.description:
Complete a timed set of mixed enzyme short-answer questions and note any gaps.

Done when: Finish the timed set within 35 minutes and list two topics needing further review.

Quest.title: Enzymes recall: inhibitors and cofactors
Quest.description:
Write definitions and examples of competitive and non-competitive inhibition, plus cofactor roles.

Done when: Produce a comparison table with correct definitions for both inhibitor types and one cofactor example.

Quest.title: Enzymes practice: inhibition and cofactors
Quest.description:
Answer applied questions comparing competitive and non-competitive inhibition and cofactor effects.

Done when: Complete at least five applied questions and correct any wrong comparisons.

Quest.title: Learn the chain rule statement and notation
Quest.description:
Work through the chain rule statement, its derivative notation, and how it applies to a composite function. Write out the rule in words and symbols and apply it to three simple composites.

Done when: Write the chain rule in words and symbols and show worked derivatives for three simple composite functions.

Quest.title: Learn chain rule with polynomial and root composites
Quest.description:
Study worked examples where the outer function is a power and the inner function is a polynomial or root expression. Record each step and note where the inner derivative is multiplied.

Done when: Complete a written set of four worked polynomial or root composites showing the inner derivative at each step.

Quest.title: Learn chain rule with trigonometric and exponential composites
Quest.description:
Work through composites where the outer function is trigonometric or exponential and the inner function is linear or polynomial. Write the derivative steps and label the inner and outer derivatives.

Done when: Write worked derivatives for four trigonometric or exponential composites, labelling the inner and outer derivatives in each.

Quest.title: Recall the chain rule statement and structure
Quest.description:
Without notes, write the chain rule statement, identify inner and outer functions for five composites, and state the derivative structure. Then check against notes and mark what was missing.

Done when: Write the chain rule from memory, label inner and outer parts for five composites, and list any gaps found after checking.

Quest.title: Orientation to composite functions and the chain rule
Quest.description:
Map what a composite function is, how inner and outer parts are identified, and where the chain rule appears in the supplied material. Produce a one-page orientation map with two labelled examples of inner and outer functions.

Done when: Submit a one-page orientation map naming inner and outer parts for two composite functions and listing the chain rule steps in order.

Quest.title: Second mistake review before the mastery check
Quest.description:
Review any remaining errors from the nested composite practice, rewrite the correct chain rule steps, and list the error patterns to watch during the final check.

Done when: Submit corrected workings for remaining errors and a short list of error patterns to watch.

Quest.title: Bounded chain rule check
Quest.description:
Complete a bounded mixed check covering the chain rule for composite functions, including polynomial, trigonometric, exponential, and nested composites. Record which items were correct and which need further work.

Done when: Complete the check and record which items were correct and which need further work.

Quest.title: Guided practice with polynomial composites
Quest.description:
Differentiate a set of polynomial composites using the chain rule. Show the inner derivative and outer derivative separately before combining them.

Done when: Complete six polynomial composite derivatives with inner and outer derivative steps shown for each.

Quest.title: Mixed practice with trigonometric and exponential composites
Quest.description:
Differentiate a mixed set of trigonometric and exponential composites. For each item, identify the inner function before differentiating.

Done when: Complete six mixed composite derivatives with the inner function identified for each item.

Quest.title: Second recall of chain rule steps and common composites
Quest.description:
From memory, write the chain rule steps and differentiate three composites of different types. Then compare with notes and record any step that was missed.

Done when: Write the chain rule steps from memory, differentiate three composites, and record any missed steps after checking.

Quest.title: Timed chain rule practice under light time pressure
Quest.description:
Differentiate a set of composite functions within a fixed short time. Record the time taken and mark any item where the inner derivative was omitted or misapplied.

Done when: Complete one timed set within the planned minutes, then review the incorrect steps.

Quest.title: Review chain rule mistakes from practice
Quest.description:
Inspect errors from the practice items, classify each as an inner-function, outer-function, or combination error, and rework the incorrect items correctly.

Done when: Classify each practice error by type and submit corrected workings for every incorrect item.

Quest.title: Applied chain rule practice with nested composites
Quest.description:
Differentiate nested composites that require the chain rule more than once, and show the order in which each inner derivative is applied.

Done when: Complete four nested composite derivatives showing each inner derivative in the correct order.
